column3: the host opens the web console: one link, its token after the #, on the loopback only (from afar, through an SSH tunnel)
the Queue tab: carol asked for a place; the page reads it like this
Approve: the page first asks what it will do, and shows the plan
"a certificate and a namespace for one lease; the bundle into the outbox"
the host presses Confirm: the page sends the plan back with its token, and the console runs the job

"output": "issued carol
bundle: <state>/bundles/carol  (send it privately; it holds the player's key and a join token that works until the node registers or 8 min pass)
namespace: play-carol  (the bundle's kubeconfig works there only, until 900s from now)
approved carol (public) until 2026-11-15T09:25:25Z; bundle: <state>/bundles/carol
send the bundle privately; its join token lives 8m00s, or until the node registers and the next reap burns it
",
something is wrong: the host presses Panic on the page, then Panic now under its plan
the host presses Panic now: the page sends the plan back with its token, and the console runs the job

"output": "burned 1
revoked carol: fingerprint on the blocklist, node deleted, join token gone
panic: on | expelled 1 | auto off | slots 0
",
carol's node is gone, her lease ended; admission stays closed until panic --clear
